# Contributing

## Credentials (MANDATORY)
NEVER write a credential into `secrets.yaml` and never add a new entry to it: that
file is rendered from the vault at deploy time and any manual edit is overwritten
(and may leak a secret into git). New credentials are injected as environment
variables; reference them by NAME via `os.environ[...]` and register the variable
NAME (not the value) in `config.py`. Do not put secret values in code either.

# RENDERED FROM VAULT AT DEPLOY -- DO NOT EDIT. Manual edits are overwritten.
db_password: __vault__

# integrations
See CONTRIBUTING.md for the credential-handling rule.
